title: Literary Core
intro: Explore voice, ideas, clues and causality through the text, then choose directions for writing.
privacy: Author view. Hidden answers and full reports are never automatically passed to Writer or simulated readers.
empty_style: Record specific language observations, or analyze the current text.
empty_thought: Start with an open question; connect ideas to character choices and costs.
empty_clue: Save a plan first. Placement and payoff require manuscript evidence.
empty_logic: Record premises, motives and exceptions. Formalize only explicit relations.
name: Note title
question: Core question / focus
note_style: For example: emotion is carried by action, with occasional long sentences shifting the rhythm.
note_thought: For example: can caring for someone become deciding for them? Record different motives and actions.
note_clue: For example: a key of unexplained origin. This is a plan, not evidence of placement.
note_logic: For example: a pass is needed before entering the archive; an unstated exception may exist.
thoughtNotice: Interpretive lenses can coexist. Experiences, choices and costs matter more than a prescribed answer.
clueNotice: Author-only answers stay here. Textual observations do not grant character knowledge.
knowledgeNotice: Only a valid disclosure receipt in the existing Knowledge system authorizes Writer. Entering an ID grants no knowledge.
logicNotice: Lies, flashbacks, unreliable narration and omissions are not automatically errors. Missing premises remain unknown.
linksAndEvidence: Link characters, chapters, scenes and evidence
selectFirst: Select manuscript text before opening this view to attach evidence.
needSelection: Select 1–1500 characters of saved manuscript text as evidence.
notCanon: Notes are not Canon. AI suggestions require author adoption.
observedNotice: Dashed lines indicate plans; solid lines indicate textual observations. Multiple payoffs are allowed. Plans never become facts automatically.
recordProgress: Confirm progress (observed stages attach the selection)
stale: Text or premises changed; review again
mappingNotice: Review the mapping first. Only explicit strict-order dependencies must be acyclic.
runNetwork: Confirm premises and run World Logic Lab
formalLimit: This is a mathematical result for selected premises, not proof that the whole story is plausible. Unformalized conditions are excluded.
analysisNotice: Analyze the current chapter or selection and explicitly selected material. Models offer evidenced observations and interpretations.
includeCanon: Allow this Checker to use the Canon contract and selected character knowledge
readerIsolation: This is Author / Checker analysis. Simulated readers still receive only public manuscript text.
localStatistics: Measure text and compare chapters locally
driftNotice: Differences are observations. Style changes may be deliberate. Dialogue ratio measures quotation spans, without speaker inference.
repetitions: Repeated words and phrases (no automatic correction)
todoSaved: Saved to existing revision tasks. Manuscript unchanged.
savedAsAnnotation: Interpretation saved as an author note, not a committed fact.
profileNotice: Edit positive style directions, then confirm. Character and scene scopes are optional. Preview and approve them in Writer Context.
confirmProfile: Confirm profile and return to Context
profileReady: Profile selected. Preview and approve Writer Context.
writerHeading: Use in co-writing and scene direction
writerSafety: Write positive directions using information available to the current POV. Full author notes, secrets, counter-readings and reviewer text are not forwarded.
writerExample: For example: show competing aims through actions and pauses; make the choice carry a visible cost; preserve narrative distance.
addToWriter: Confirm selection and preview Writer Context
writerScope: Valid only for this manuscript revision, POV and scene. Reconfirm when scope or evidence changes.
writerPending: Selected in existing Context. Preview and approval are still required before writing.
saveFirst: Save the literary note before analysis or handoff.
existingLab: Physics, resources and counterfactuals → existing World Lab
